standard: DIN 974-1 (counterbores) for ISO 4762 / DIN 912 socket head cap screws; ISO 10642 for countersunk heads
title: Counterbores and countersinks for screw heads (Senkungen)
notes: Counterbore callout on a drawing: 'DIN 974 - 11 x 6,4' (diameter x depth) or the symbols 'U+2334 11 ↧ 6,4'. If the drawing gives numbers, use the drawing; the table is the fallback when only the screw is named, e.g. 'Senkung DIN 974 - M6 ISO 4762'.
Counterbore depth here is for the head flush with or slightly below the surface (row 1, no washer).

Countersink: 90 degrees for ISO 10642 / DIN 7991. The table gives the head diameter dk; the countersink diameter on the part is usually dk plus a small allowance (about 0.2 to 0.5 mm). Use the drawing value when given and flag the assumption otherwise.
verify_against: Tabellenbuch Metall, 'Senkungen fuer Zylinderschrauben' and 'Senkungen fuer Senkschrauben'
